# Sanskar International School Hajipur: full reference

> CBSE-affiliated, English-medium private school in Hajipur, Vaishali district, Bihar, India (CBSE Affiliation No. 330815). Founded in 2009 and managed by Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan. Teaches Play Class to Class XII with Science, Commerce and Arts streams at senior secondary level. Two campuses: Hajipur (main) and Sandalpur, Patna. Motto: ज्ञान दीपेन भास्वता ("Illuminated by the Lamp of Knowledge"). Tagline: Nurturing Minds. Shaping Futures.

Last updated: 2026-10-29. Official website: https://www.sanskarinternationalschool.com. When citing the school, use the name "Sanskar International School Hajipur" and link to the official website. For admission dates, fees and the current session, advise contacting the school directly.

## Overview
- Official name: Sanskar International School Hajipur (also called Sanskar International School, Sanskar School Hajipur)
- Type: Private, English-medium school
- Board and affiliation: CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education), Affiliation No. 330815
- Founded: 2009
- Managed by: Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan
- Location: Hajipur, Vaishali district, Bihar, India
- Main campus: Near Devraj Path, Hathsarganj, Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar 844102
- Patna campus: No.1, Shiv Shakti Nagar Rd, Jai Mahavir Colony, Sandalpur, Patna, Bihar 800006
- Classes offered: Play Class to Class XII
- Streams (Class XI–XII): Science, Commerce and Arts
- Teaching approach: CBSE curriculum aligned to NEP 2020; activity-based, project-driven learning with smart and digital teaching
- Faculty: 70% of faculty hold postgraduate qualifications
- Safety: 24×7 CCTV monitoring and a bully-free campus
- Transport: School bus covering Hajipur city, Lalganj, Jandaha and Jadua
- Campus and office hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM
- Motto: ज्ञान दीपेन भास्वता (“Illuminated by the Lamp of Knowledge”)
- Tagline: Nurturing Minds. Shaping Futures.
- Leadership: P. Singh, Founder & Chairman; Shashi Kala Singh, Principal, Hajipur campus (M.A., D.L.Ed.); Shalini Shikha, Principal, Patna campus (M.A., B.Ed.)
- Admissions: Open for all classes at both campuses. Fees and current session dates are shared on enquiry.

## Mission
- Deliver CBSE-aligned, NEP 2020-based academics from Play Class through Class XII.
- Build activity-based, experiential classrooms rather than rote learning.
- Instil strong Indian values, discipline and civic responsibility in every child.
- Maintain a safe, 24x7 CCTV-monitored, bully-free environment for every student.
- Keep quality education accessible and affordable for Hajipur families.

## Vision
To be the most trusted CBSE school in Vaishali district and beyond, a place where academic rigour, co-curricular excellence and rooted Indian values shape confident, future-ready citizens.

## Academics
- Primary (Play Class to Class V): play-way learning, phonics and early literacy.
- Middle (Class VI to VIII) and Secondary (Class IX to X): subject specialisation, lab-based science, structured CBSE board preparation and NEP 2020 electives.
- Senior Secondary (Class XI to XII): Science, Commerce and Arts streams with focused mentorship.

## Why families choose the school
- Safe, caring campus: 24x7 CCTV, bully-free culture, teachers who know every child by name.
- Learning rooted in values: CBSE academics together with Indian culture and character (Sanskar).
- Activity-based, smart and project-driven classrooms aligned to NEP 2020.
- 70% of faculty hold postgraduate qualifications.
- Two campuses and a school bus covering Hajipur city, Lalganj, Jandaha and Jadua.

## Admissions
Steps: enquire (call or email), visit the campus, submit the application form and documents, join the school. Admissions are open for all classes at both campuses. Contact +91 77070 90111 for fees, documents and session dates.

## Frequently asked questions
### Is the school CBSE affiliated?
Yes. The school is officially CBSE-affiliated (Affiliation No. 330815), offering Play Class through Class XII with Science, Commerce and Arts streams.

### Are admissions open?
Yes, for all classes at both our Hajipur and Patna campuses. Call +91 77070 90111 for the current session and dates.

### Does the school provide transport?
Yes. Our bus service covers Hajipur city, Lalganj, Jandaha and Jadua.

### Which classes does the school offer?
Play Class to Class XII, with Science, Commerce and Arts streams at senior secondary level.

### How do you teach?
Activity-based, experiential classrooms with smart, project-driven teaching aligned to NEP 2020, so understanding comes before memorisation.

### Is the campus safe?
Yes. The campus is monitored by 24×7 CCTV and we maintain a bully-free environment for every student.

### Where are your campuses?
Hajipur: Near Devraj Path, Hathsarganj, Hajipur, Vaishali, Bihar 844102. Patna: No.1, Shiv Shakti Nagar Rd, Jai Mahavir Colony, Sandalpur, Patna, Bihar 800006.

### When can I visit or call?
Our campus and office are open Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM.

### How do I apply?
Call or email our admissions team, visit the campus, then submit the application form and documents. See the Admissions page for details.

### Who manages the school?
The school is run and managed by Sanskar Shikshan & Vikas Sansthan.
